messages.subject: [MonetDB.R] MonetDB.R 0.9.6 pre-release
messages.body_plain:
Hello MonetDB.R users,

It?s been a while, but we are almost ready to upload a new version of MonetDB.R to CRAN. The main changes are

- monetdb.read.csv new create= parameter (Thanks, Duncan)
- deprecated nrows parameter to monetdb.read.csv, not neccessary any more because of changes to MonetDB
- Fixed non-ASCII character handling (Thanks, Roman)
- Fully removed C-based socket code
- support for dplyr verbs sample_n() and sample_frac()

Preliminary versions are available at [1]. If you have some time, it would be great if you could try out the new version and report back before Friday (2015-03-20).

Best,

Hannes

[1] http://homepages.cwi.nl/~hannes/R/

messages.subject: [MonetDB.R] MonetDB.R 0.9.6
messages.body_plain:
Hello MonetDB.R users,

I would like to announce that the new version of MonetDB.R (0.9.6) was added to CRAN.

Changes:

0.9.6
- monetdb.read.csv new create= parameter (Thanks, Duncan)
- deprecated nrows parameter to monetdb.read.csv, not neccessary any more because of changes to MonetDB
- Fixed non-ASCII character handling (Thanks, Roman)
- Fully removed C-based socket code
- support for dplyr verbs sample_n() and sample_frac()

Best,

Hannes
